questions.question: State the observation that confirms the presence of a carbon–carbon double bond when a sample of an alkene is treated with bromine water.
Explain why the addition of hydrogen bromide to propene gives a major product and a minor product, indicating the relative stability of the intermediates involved.
Describe the mechanism for the electrophilic addition of bromine to 1‑butene, including the role of the double bond and the formation of the bromonium ion.
A laboratory experiment shows that 10.0 g of 1‑hexene reacts with excess HBr to give 12.5 g of 1‑bromohexane. Calculate the percent yield of the reaction.
Compare the polymer repeat unit of poly(ethene) with that of poly(1‑butene) and explain how the structure of the monomer influences the properties of the resulting polymer.
